change.content: Always default to JSON Schema Draft-07 for maximum compatibility. Many users still use older schemas, and Draft-07 validators are the most widely supported. When $schema field is missing or ambiguous, force Draft-07 mode by adding $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema# to the schema file before validation. This avoids compatibility issues with older tools.

entries.summary: Force Draft-07 as default schema version for compatibility

change.content: When validation errors mention $dynamicRef or $dynamicAnchor, these are Draft 2020-12 features not supported by most validators. Suggest the user rewrite their schema using $ref and definitions instead, which are compatible with Draft-07.
